positions.name: Tesla, Inc.
positions.catalyst: Fri Oct 16: Tesla unveiled the redesigned Roadster with SpaceX-developed cold-gas thruster tech (production 2028); TSLA +4.6% pre-mkt (379.00 vs 362.44 close) and the #1 trending ticker on Stocktwits. Also in focus: TSMC 'Terafab' talks with Musk. Broad tape calm: SPY +0.2%, QQQ flat, IWM +0.4% after Thursday's recovery from the semis selloff.
positions.driver: Fresh, company-specific catalyst with retail momentum on a day when the macro edge is thin (QQQ flat, hot PPI 6.3% / hawkish Hammack already digested). Unleveraged (6% stop) because the edge is moderate: product-event pops can fade and it is monthly opex Friday. Chose TSLA over TSLL (2x, +9% pre-mkt = at the no-chase line), SOXS (+2.6% pre-mkt, 5th day of chip selling, Thursday's SOXS faded hard from the open), SQQQ hold (Nasdaq flat, thesis broke), BTC-USD/BITX (BTC ~82.1k drifting, no catalyst).
positions.risks: Sell-the-news on a product that doesn't ship until 2028; energy-division exec departure headline; opex pinning; renewed AI/semis liquidation dragging mega-cap tech. Stop 356.26 (-6%) sits below Thursday's 362.44 close, so a full gap-fill alone won't trigger it.
